ios.desc:
Turn one idea into thousands of ready-to-post visuals.

SMMAI is a free, AI-powered app for creating social media posts, stories, and banners. Add your text and image and get multiple ready-made design options in seconds. Or use AI to generate text and images from scratch — for free.
SMMAI is now fully native: faster, more stable, and redesigned to make creating banners even simpler.

CREATE SOCIAL POSTS IN MINUTES
• Add text and an image — SMMAI automatically creates multiple layout variations.
• Or use AI to generate copy and a matching image.
• Browse your options in one grid and quickly find the right design.
• Pick a version, make quick edits, and export a ready-to-post PNG.

MADE FOR SOCIAL MEDIA
• Core formats: 1200×1200, 1080×1920, and 1200×628.
• Great for Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Pinterest, Telegram, Snapchat, and more.
• Modern, minimalist compositions for posts, stories, and banners.

WHY SMMAI
• Fast: go from idea to finished visual in seconds.
• Simple: no complicated design tools to learn.
• More choice: see many different compositions at once instead of starting from one template.
• Free AI: text and image generation remain free.
• No sign-up: start creating right away.
• No watermark: export clean, ready-to-use images.
• Native app: a fast, stable interface built specifically for iOS.

KEY FEATURES
• AI-powered social post, story, and banner maker.
• Thousands of minimalist layouts and templates.
• AI text generation.
• AI image and background generation.
• Upload your own images.
• Text size, alignment, and placement controls.
• Quickly preview multiple design variations.
• Export ready-to-post PNGs with no watermark.
• No sign-up or subscription required to get started.

WHO IT’S FOR
• Social media managers and content creators who need fresh visuals fast.
• Small businesses and founders who want quality posts without a designer.
• Freelancers and students creating social media content.
• Anyone looking for a simple AI banner maker instead of a complex graphic editor.

HOW IT WORKS 
1. Pick a format: 1200×1200, 1080×1920, or 1200×628. 
2. Add a headline, subheadline, and image. 
3. Or ask AI to generate the text and image. 
4. Browse the automatically generated design options. 
5. Choose one, edit it, and save a ready-to-post PNG.

WHAT YOU CAN CREATE
• A social media post or story.
• A product, event, or sale announcement.
• An advertising banner.
• Quote cards, tips, and educational content.
• Cover graphics for chan

quotes.text:
Hi, thanks for checking it out.

Creating social media graphics is a five-minute task that can stretch into hours. It requires complex tools and basic design skills. Not everyone has time to learn Figma or Photoshop for a single post.

SMMAI works differently: instead of manually building one layout, it instantly generates hundreds of ready-made options. You pick a format, add an image and text (or generate them with AI), and get a grid of templates in the right sizes (square for feed, vertical for stories, horizontal for posts). You scroll, pick one you like, tweak it a bit, and you're done.

I think of it as "vibe design": design becomes more like browsing. No building from scratch, just choosing what already works.

You can try it here:
- Web app: https://smmai.app/
- iOS app: https://apps.apple.com/app/smmai-social-media-templates/id6469481413

More info: https://home.smmai.app

I'd especially appreciate feedback from people who:
• create or ship a lot of social media content
• work on tools for generative / layout design

A couple of questions:
1. Does this "many options first, polish later" approach actually help you move faster, or does it just create noise?
2. What would you want to automate next around social posts (copy, asset management, brand constraints, something else)?

Happy to answer questions about the product, how it works, and where I'd like to take it next.
quotes.story_title: Show HN: Smmai – a "vibe design" generator for social media banners
